allocation_probe_scope: Separate direct CpuExecutor probe counts replaceable global C++ operator new/new[] and aligned forms using a thread-local counter; excludes malloc/mmap, input copies, timing records, pool setup and worker-thread allocations. Runtime mode has no allocation probe.
rss_scope: Resident pages from /proc/self/statm times page size; sampled with Runtime still alive after warmup and after timing. Includes model, workspaces, threads, bounded pending futures, latency vectors and allocator retention; results consumed and destroyed promptly.
peak_rss_scope: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) ru_maxrss process high-water mark, Linux KiB converted to bytes; includes startup, preparation, warmup, timing and reporting, not executor-only peak.
timing_scope: Formal wall time includes input copies, submissions, rejected attempts, ready-future scans, waits, successful result consumption/destruction and metric recording; setup, warmup, allocation probe, final shutdown and reporting excluded.
latency_scope: Successful requests only: call-before (before owned input copy) to future.get result acquisition. queue=start-enqueued under queue lock; execution=finish-start (callable); completion=finish-call-before; collection=acquired-finish; submit=submit-return-call-before. Direct execution has zero queue/collection. All stages include instrumentation overhead.
latency_percentile_method: nearest-rank: sorted sample at ceil(p*N), one-indexed
